text:
people-ops: Quick share — drafted a tiny pack of 3-line skip-level / sprint-review prompts for managers to use in calibration and 1:1 prep. Wanted to drop here for quick feedback before we push to the handbook. cc @jules @sam.w :sparkles:

people-ops: TL;DR templates (each = one sentence impact, one evidence bullet, one next-step). Examples below — feel free to tweak wording. Full doc: https://redwood.doc/skiplevel-micropack

people-ops: ```
Impact: Consolidated onboarding docs reduced time-to-first-success by ~25%.
Evidence: Led doc sprint + 4 cross-team walkthroughs; onboarding CS NPS improved from 66->78.
Next step: Lead next quarter’s intake to scale to APAC hires.
```

sam.w: nice — these are short enough to paste into calibration notes. Can we add a 1-line "confidence" marker? like "confidence: high/medium/low" so reviewers know how much evidence backing there is?

people-ops: good call. adding a one-word confidence tag would help reviewers triage. will add an optional fourth line.

priya: love the brevity. for IC -> manager upward feedback, suggest swapping "next step" to "support needed" so it becomes actionable for managers.

jules: +1 to priya. also can we include a micro-template for stretch goals? something like:

jules: ```
Stretch: Own a cross-team infra metric to drive latency < 200ms.
Why now: Increasing API adoption created P95 regressions during Q2.
Support: Need 0.4 FTE from eng infra for 6 weeks to instrument and test.
```

emily.p: This looks super workable. One logistical Q: who is the canonical owner to maintain the doc? People-ops or manager-tooling?

people-ops: people-ops will maintain the canonical copy, but we'll accept PRs from manager-tooling for any format/CSV exports. We'll version with date tags.

sam.w: tiny nit: could we add a "paste into Slack" single-line variant for quick syncs? e.g., `Impact — Evidence — Support` compressed.

people-ops: yep, adding a compressed variant and a handful of pre-written examples for common roles (engineering, product, CS).

people-ops-bot: Reminder: new handbook page "Skip-level micro-templates" will go live 2024-07-15. Watch for post in #announcements. :bell:

priya: awesome — happy to pilot with my org next week and report back.

jules: I can share examples from my last calibration to seed the compressed list.

people-ops: thanks all! will update the doc by EOD and ping for final quick thumbs. :heart:
